description: No recent deploy. Latency and error rate climb together, correlated with repeated payment-gateway health check failures in the logs. A postmortem from 3 months ago describes the same downstream dependency failing the same way. Correct root cause: the downstream dependency, not checkout-service itself.
correct_root_cause_summary: payment-gateway (a downstream dependency) became unavailable; checkout-service's aggressive retry policy amplified the impact. No deploy to checkout-service caused this.

alert.message: checkout-service error rate exceeded 5% for 5 minutes
